registros.pergunta: Qual foi o campeão com a maior taxa de banimento em 2026?

resultados.sql:
SELECT c.champion_name
FROM bans b
JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = b.match_id
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT champion_id, champion_name FROM participants) c
  ON c.champion_id = b.champion_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.game_creation) = 2026
GROUP BY c.champion_name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id)::float / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matches WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM game_creation) = 2026) DESC
LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Qual equipe teve a maior sequência de vitórias consecutivas em 2026?

resultados.sql:
SELECT team_name, MAX(seq) AS maior_sequencia FROM (
  SELECT team_name, COUNT(*) AS seq FROM (
    SELECT team_name, win,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_name ORDER BY game_date, game_id)
         - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_name, win ORDER BY game_date, game_id) AS grp
    FROM pro_games WHERE year = 2026) t
  WHERE win GROUP BY team_name, grp) s
GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY maior_sequencia DESC LIMIT 1;

FROM (
  SELECT team_name, COUNT(*) AS seq
  FROM (
    SELECT team_name, win,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_name ORDER BY game_date, game_id)
         - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_name, win ORDER BY game_date, game_id) AS grp
    FROM pro_games
  ) t
  WHERE NOT win
  GROUP BY team_name, grp
) s
GROUP BY team_name

LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Quais foram os 5 campeões com maior presença em picks ou bans em 2026?

resultados.sql:
SELECT champion_name, COUNT(*) AS presenca
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT match_id, champion_name
  FROM participants
  WHERE champion_name IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT game_creation FROM matches m WHERE m.match_id = participants.match_id)) = 2026
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT b.match_id, p.champion_name
  FROM bans b
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT champion_id, champion_name FROM participants) p
    ON p.champion_id = b.champion_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT game_creation FROM matches m WHERE m.match_id = b.match_id)) = 2026
) combined
GROUP BY champion_name
ORDER BY presenca DESC
LIMIT 5;

registros.pergunta: Qual foi a diferença na taxa de vitória de um mesmo campeão entre os lados azul e vermelho?

resultados.sql:
SELECT 
  p.champion_name,
  AVG(p.win::int) FILTER (WHERE t.team_id = 100) AS win_rate_azul,
  AVG(p.win::int) FILTER (WHERE t.team_id = 200) AS win_rate_vermelho,
  AVG(p.win::int) FILTER (WHERE t.team_id = 100) - AVG(p.win::int) FILTER (WHERE t.team_id = 200) AS diferenca
FROM participants p
JOIN teams t ON t.match_id = p.match_id AND t.team_id = p.team_id
GROUP BY p.champion_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY ABS(AVG(p.win::int) FILTER (WHERE t.team_id = 100) - AVG(p.win::int) FILTER (WHERE t.team_id = 200)) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

registros.pergunta: Qual dupla de campeões de ADC e SUPPORT teve a maior taxa de vitória, considerando pelo menos 20 partidas?

resultados.sql:
WITH dupla_adc_sup AS (
  SELECT 
    p_adc.champion_name AS adc,
    p_sup.champion_name AS support,
    p_adc.match_id,
    p_adc.win
  FROM participants p_adc
  JOIN participants p_sup 
    ON p_adc.match_id = p_sup.match_id 
    AND p_adc.team_id = p_sup.team_id
  WHERE p_adc.team_position = 'BOTTOM'
    AND p_sup.team_position = 'UTILITY'
)
SELECT 
  adc,
  support,
  AVG(win::int) AS win_rate
FROM dupla_adc_sup
GROUP BY adc, support
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY win_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Qual campeão apresentou a maior diferença de KDA médio entre vitórias e derrotas?

resultados.sql:
SELECT champion_name, 
       AVG(CASE WHEN win THEN (kills + assists)::float / NULLIF(deaths, 0) ELSE NULL END) 
         FILTER (WHERE win) AS kda_vitoria,
       AVG(CASE WHEN NOT win THEN (kills + assists)::float / NULLIF(deaths, 0) ELSE NULL END) 
         FILTER (WHERE NOT win) AS kda_derrota,
       AVG(CASE WHEN win THEN (kills + assists)::float / NULLIF(deaths, 0) ELSE NULL END) 
         FILTER (WHERE win) 
       - AVG(CASE WHEN NOT win THEN (kills + assists)::float / NULLIF(deaths, 0) ELSE NULL END) 
         FILTER (WHERE NOT win) AS diferenca_kda
FROM participants
GROUP BY champion_name
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE win) >= 20 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT win) >= 20
ORDER BY diferenca_kda DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
